# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Rogue level 8 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Rogue
# level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4/level-5/level-6/level-7 chassis baseline to
# level 8 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/skill posture from the level-1..level-7 fixtures, adding only
# the level bump this bounded tranche needs. Rogue grants no talent
# choice-slot line here (rogue talents are a level-2+/4+/6+/8+ choice-list
# feature this slice deliberately does not implement — a genuinely
# open-ended talent tree, not a flat arithmetic burden), so no new choice=
# line is required beyond the level-1..level-7 baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Rogue burden surface: no check-execution
# engine, no trap DC resolution, no magic-trap disarm engine, no rogue
# talent, and no level-9+ progression. The PF1 Core Rulebook Rogue class
# table's level-8 "Special" column reads "Improved uncanny dodge, rogue
# talent" (verified independently against d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com) —
# the sneak attack die count stays at 4 (i.e. 4d6, via the pre-existing
# (level + 1) / 2 formula: (8 + 1) / 2 = 4, unchanged from level 7 — sneak
# attack traditionally rises only at odd rogue levels); Trap Sense's own flat
# magnitude stays at +2 (rogue level / 3, floor: 8 / 3 = 2, unchanged from
# level 7 — the next Trap Sense rise is at 9th level, beyond this bounded
# slice); Trapfinding genuinely rises to +4 (max(8 / 2, 1) = 4, up from +3 at
# level 7, via the same pre-existing formula); Improved Uncanny Dodge is
# newly granted at level 8 and is grounded as a bounded identity/recognition
# record only (mirroring exactly how Barbarian's own Improved Uncanny Dodge
# was grounded at barbarian level 5); the level-8 row's OTHER named entry, a
# third Rogue Talent slot, is deliberately left named-but-unproven, mirroring
# the level-2/level-4/level-6 rogue-talent precedent.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-rogue-level8
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:rogue:8
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:17
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:12
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:weapon_finesse
skill=skill:stealth:1
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:dexterity
